text: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.
The strong man is not the one who is good at wrestling, but the strong man is the one who controls himself in a fit of rage.
None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.
He who treads a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make the path to Paradise easy for him.
